changelog:
Initial release of agenthost.

- Publish static sites or Markdown docs and receive a private, pre-authenticated share link with no signup required.
- Supports single file (.md/.html) or entire folders (via gzipped tar).
- Markdown sites render with a sidebar; supports GitBook-style navigation, GFM, and mermaid diagrams.
- Redeploy easily using an ownerToken; each deployment is isolated by unique subdomain.
- Built-in file and site size limits; automatic site expiration after 15 days of inactivity.
- Features like public sharing, token management, and API references available in documentation.
summary: Publishes a static site or a folder of Markdown docs to a hosted URL and returns a private, pre-authenticated share link. Use when the user wants to publish a site/html/markdowns or share with someone else.
